tasks.title: Setup PostgreSQL database schema with all tables (users, notes, study_groups, group_members, group_messages, note_ratings) and relationships
Implement user registration and JWT authentication endpoints with email verification flow
Configure AWS S3 bucket for file storage and implement secure file upload/download endpoints
Build React frontend authentication screens (login, registration) with mobile-responsive design matching UI specifications
Develop notes sharing API endpoints (upload, search, download) and integrate with S3
Create Notes Library and Note Detail screens with search, filter, and rating display functionality
Implement study group creation, join, and management API endpoints with member role handling
Build Study Groups and Group Discussion screens with real-time messaging interface
Develop group discussion forum API with message posting and retrieval endpoints
Implement note rating and review system API with average rating calculation
Create Home Dashboard and User Profile screens with stats, navigation, and content display
Add database indexes on frequently queried columns (email, subject, created_at, group_id) for performance optimization
Implement frontend state management and API integration for all features using React hooks
Conduct end-to-end testing of user flows (registration, note upload/download, group creation/join, messaging)
Deploy backend to production environment and configure environment variables for AWS S3 and database

risks: AWS S3 integration complexity may delay file upload/download functionality
Real-time messaging implementation could require WebSocket setup beyond initial scope
University email verification may need third-party service integration
Database performance issues with large file metadata and message volume without proper indexing
Mobile responsiveness testing across multiple devices may reveal UI inconsistencies requiring design iterations
